_doc: Aegean Shore bosses (GAME_DESIGN.md: Bosses; Regional boss roster). Each has 3 phases at HP thresholds, patterns from the shared library (data in config patterns, overridden here), named casts with cast bars, a Guard gauge (damage fills it, weakness hits fill it x2; when full: Guard Break, stunned 4 s, +50% damage taken, cast cancelled, then the gauge refills slower), and one signature mechanic from its myth. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS.
lore_source: Hesiod, Theogony 270-281; Pseudo-Apollodorus, Bibliotheca 2.4.2-3; Ovid, Metamorphoses 4
Homer, Iliad; Statius, Achilleid 1.269 (the dip in the Styx); the heel: Hyginus, Fabulae 107
Hesiod, Theogony 137-210, 453-506 (Kronos the Titan, who swallowed his children)
